scope: Offline OEM APK interaction research only; no renderer, application code, worktree code, phone, or network operation.

source.offset_convention: Absolute byte offsets in the named uncompressed DEX, not method-relative offsets.

slide_speed.units: degrees per second per held gesture-delta pixel, as used by APK update

automatic_rotation_speed.units: degrees per second about world Y

damping_rate.units: per second for linear interpolation alpha=damp*dt

camera_distance_fractions.note: Relative to default eye-center distance; refreshMinMaxDis replaces constructor placeholders.

input.coordinate_units: Android MotionEvent.getX/getY view-local pixels, truncated to int before subtracting.
input.gesture_delta: deltaX=int(eventX)-lastX; deltaY=int(eventY)-lastY; lastX/Y updated on each event.
input.getters: getSlideDeltaX/Y convert stored ints to float and do not consume/reset them. Delta remains held between touch events.
input.single_pointer: One pointer enables sliding; changing pointer count ends sliding. UP/CANCEL ends sliding and clears gesture delta.
input.two_pointer: Pinch distance difference becomes scrollValue; targetDistance += scrollValue*(-0.6)*dt, clamped to configured near/far.
input.touch_listener: If not Control, a touch event enters Control and starts control timing. While Control, UP/CANCEL enters ControlOver. Every processed event resets noTouchTime to zero.

frame_time.minimum_guard_note: Elapsed <=10ms is skipped; frameStep can additionally skip frames.

exact_apk_algorithms.lerp: Lerp(a,b,t)=a*(1-t)+b*t, with no internal t clamp. Math.Companion.lerp(float,float,float) code0x2f108c.
control_step: angleX = currentSlide.x*(-21*dt); rotate current look vector about world Y by angleX.
Convert look rotation to Euler; pitch += currentSlide.y*(-21*dt); clamp pitch to [-85,+85] degrees.
Rebuild center quaternion/matrix; currentDistance=Lerp(currentDistance,targetDistance,alpha); place camera on the center orbit.
If no further touch event for >=3 seconds, enter ControlOver.
release_inertia: switchToControlOver sets targetSlide=(0,0) and stateTime=0; currentSlide is retained.
Each frame uses the same smoothed camera update: currentSlide *= (1-7.2*dt), with residual rotation proportional to currentSlide*dt.
There is no separately captured angular velocity, Android VelocityTracker, or fling cap in this traced controller.
When abs(currentDistance-targetDistance)<=0.01 and currentSlide.x^2+currentSlide.y^2<=0.01, enter ControlOverToRotate.
automatic_resume: On entering ControlOverToRotate, currentRotateSpeed=2*rotateSpeed (default40 degrees/second), stateTime=0.
UpdateRotate(dt) runs immediately in this state; auto rotation is not delayed until the 10 seconds finish.
All lerps use the updated current values each frame, not a fixed release snapshot. The state lasts10 seconds, but the restoring curve is not a10-second linear interpolation.
At t>=1 enter Rotate, setting currentRotateSpeed=rotateSpeed.
exact_apk_algorithms.rotate_step: Rotate the negated current center-forward direction about world Y by currentRotateSpeed*dt degrees, reconstruct orientation with world-up=(0,1,0), recompose the orbit camera matrix.
exact_apk_algorithms.reset_only_idle: resetImmediately resets center then enters Idle; Idle waits0.5 seconds and enters Rotate. Ordinary release does not pass through Idle.
exact_apk_algorithms.reset_recover: startReset enters Recover: default1-second easeInOutCubic progress drives quaternion slerp to default orientation and distance lerp; then Rotate.
exact_apk_algorithms.initial_state: Constructor resets center/near-far and directly enters Rotate.
exact_apk_algorithms.lifecycle: onEnable attaches touch listener. onDisable detaches it, ends gesture, and finishes an active Control session. SceneComponent.update and ModelScene.update check enabled/destroyed state.
exact_apk_algorithms.rotation_units_evidence: Math.rotateByYAxis at0x2f2e74 multiplies angle by0.017453292 approximately pi/180 before sin/cos.

application_override_scan.scope: Both DEX entries of the OEM APK scanned for direct calls to CameraController.setRotateSpeed/setRecoverTime.
application_override_scan.boundary: Does not exclude reflection or future SDK/application versions.

adaptation_guidance_not_apk_facts.purpose: Keep the familiar two-axis orbit/pitch clamp/residual-inertia feel while satisfying the user's slower horizontal idle rotation.
adaptation_guidance_not_apk_facts.damping_suggestion: A time-stable exponential residual velocity/delta decay exp(-7.2*dt) approximates the OEM high damping. This exponential formula is a proposed adaptation, not the APK formula.
adaptation_guidance_not_apk_facts.input_suggestion: Use the selected rendering library's orbit controller and view-local pointer coordinates; do not copy held Android pixel delta multiplied by render dt as if it were a normalized or frame-independent sensitivity.
adaptation_guidance_not_apk_facts.timing_suggestion: Use a monotonic clock and bounded animation dt after pause/resume; stop updates while the view is not active. These are desktop implementation choices.
adaptation_guidance_not_apk_facts.renderer_boundary: Use an existing rendering library for GLB import, camera and GPU drawing. This evidence does not implement any render backend.
